description: Search the live tool registry by name or description substring — the fastest way to discover which of the 500+ tools handles a job. Discovery set: find_tool/inspect_tool/toolset_report are always available (also via catalog). Use this first when unsure which verb to use (e.g., playlist vs snapshot vs search).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against tool names and descriptions

response_format.description: 'concise' (default) = prose bullet list; 'detailed' = the same prose; 'json' = the result payload as parseable JSON text, identical to structuredContent

name: find_tool
